nom: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Gentle Exfoliating Facial Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser works well twice daily, helps with breakouts, but can be drying with frequent use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin generally report hydration and softness without over-drying, though a few say it left skin tight or slightly dry, especially with daily use or on very dry/eye-area patches.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report balanced results, keeping the T-zone controlled while still hydrating drier areas, with no reported breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many report gentle cleansing with no irritation or redness, while several others describe severe reactions including burning, rash, swelling, peeling, or white splotches.
segments.mature: One mature-skin reviewer reports the cleanser is gentle, non-stripping, and hydrating for everyday use.

concerns.aging: A 60-year-old reviewer reports a noticeable improvement in moisture retention after first use; no other aging-specific outcomes are mentioned.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the cleanser hydrates without stripping thanks to hyaluronic acid, leaving skin soft and plump; a smaller number report tightness, dryness, or a burning/dry aftermath, particularly with daily use or already-dry skin.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report no redness or irritation even on sensitive skin, but multiple others report immediate redness, burning, or a rash-like reaction around the nose, mouth, or cheeks.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe reactions resembling a compromised barrier — burning, chemical-burn sensation, peeling, or white splotches that led one to see a dermatologist; most other reviewers report no such damage.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with white splotches was referred to a dermatologist; this appears isolated rather than widespread.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple reviewers, including one with acne-prone combination skin, report no new breakouts; one oily-skin reviewer says it helps with breakouts, while no reviewer reports the product causing new blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers report the cleanser removes oil and leaves no oily residue, working well for normal-to-oily skin without over-stripping according to most, though one oily-skin user notes it can be drying with twice-daily use.

aspects.libelle: Squeeze tube or jar packaging convenient

extraits.texte: I bought and used this for 4 days so far and my skin Does not like it at all. my face appears bumpy, rough, and irritated. I have slightly sensitive combination skin but my face has never reacted like this to anything.

I really wanted to like this product as I love an exfoliating face wash and my dermatologist recommended it. But alas, it caused terrible stinging burning and redness immediately even after moisturizing still very raw.

extraits.titre: Decent one for normal to oily skin type.
extraits.texte: I tried the Neutrogena Hydro Boost Exfoliating Cleanser, and it's a decent daily cleanser with mild exfoliation. It has a gel-like texture with tiny beads and lathers well. While it cleans thoroughly without being too harsh, it's not as hydrating as I expected. My skin feels fresh but slightly tight afterward, so I always need a moisturizer. It didn't cause major irritation despite my sensitive skin, but the added fragrance and sulfates might not suit everyone. Overall, it's a good option for normal to oily skin but may not be the best for very dry or sensitive skin. Rating: ⭐⭐⭐☆☆ (3/5)

I tend to have dry skin, but I see a visible difference with regular use after a few weeks. The exfoliating ingredients are not harsh on the skin and absorbs well into the face. I love how it also has hyaluronic acid (though it is the last ingredient), but it looses some points because fragrance is a listed ingredient. However, there are more pros than cons, so I would recommend this product.

extraits.titre: Plus it is suitable for all ages
extraits.texte: I really love the gentle exfoliant. I love the way it leaves such a clean feeling on my face. it could be the time of year or it could be just me but I need to moisturize my skin immediately after washing with this cleanser because it becomes extremely tight. I bought this to share with my son who has oily skin and occasional outbreaks it's great for his oily skin as well as my dry skin. The smell is wonderful, light. Ingredients: the main thing is that it does not contain soap or oil. The packaging comes in different sizes that you can take with you on a trip.

extraits.titre: Gentle exfoliating cleanser for everyday use
extraits.texte: I have combination and acne prone skin.I had always been a fan of the hydro boost gel cleanser and wanted to give this a try. I love this product as well. It thoroughly cleanses and does not leave any residue. The microbeads are great for gently exfoliating and has not irritated my skin. I have not had any break outs or other discomfort so far. I will definetly be using this product again. Value for money.

I've been using this cleanser since high school and I love it! It barely has a scent and lathers so well on the skin. I would say only use this once either in the morning or night. I have oily skin so I use it twice a day but it can dry out your skin. I do see results though and love using this daily. It's great for breakouts as well. 💧✨
